title: Max and Leo’s Big Red X
moral: Sharing and helping each other makes adventures fun.

scenes.summary: Max and Leo start an adventure using a map.
scenes.text: Max showed Leo a map with a big red X and they began their adventure.
scenes.image_prompt: two boys looking at treasure map indoors, bright cartoon

scenes.summary: They face challenges like crossing a pretend river.
scenes.text: They had to cross a laundry basket river using a stool as a bridge.
scenes.image_prompt: kids crossing laundry basket river using stool, playful cartoon

scenes.summary: They explore different places like a bush and bookshelf.
scenes.text: They explored the bush, crossed obstacles, and reached the bookshelf tower.
scenes.image_prompt: kids exploring house like jungle and climbing shelf, cartoon style

scenes.summary: They find the treasure safely with help.
scenes.text: With help from mom, they reached the top shelf and got the treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: child reaching shelf with parent support, warm cartoon

scenes.summary: They celebrate and enjoy their adventure together.
scenes.text: They shared the treasure and felt happy after their fun adventure.
scenes.image_prompt: kids sharing snacks and smiling together, cozy cartoon

story: Max and Leo used a map with a big red X to go on an adventure. They explored their house, crossed a pretend river, and climbed to find treasure. With help, they reached the shelf and got raisins and apples. They shared the treasure and enjoyed their adventure together.
